body.name: Simultaneous component-effect confidence collection
body.construction: Select \(\widehat C_n\) by \(\texttt{def:global-bic}\). On \(S_n\in\mathbb S^p_{++}\), retain member labels, evaluate every rational map \(g_E(S_n)\) and its derivative, estimate its variance from the Gaussian covariance limit, and use Bonferroni critical value \(z_{1-\alpha/(2K)}\) for the \(K\) nonconstant labelled coordinates; assign exact singleton intervals to structurally zero coordinates. On \(S_n\notin\mathbb S^p_{++}\), assign \(\mathbb R\) to every coordinate. The resulting collection is \(\mathfrak I_{n,\alpha}(\widehat C_n)\).
